difficulty_reason: The property P(f) = 'f is a local complete intersection morphism' is syntomic local on the source (schemes). The retained proof is complete: run the Descent criterion for properties local on the source — precomposition stability follows from the chapter's flat-lci dictionary (same wave, L16202) and composition closure (same wave, L16214), Zariski locality is definitional; the descent step is written out in full: for X' -> X -> Y affine with X' -> X syntomic and X' -> Y lci, lift X' -> X locally to syntomic W -> A^n_Y (Algebra, lemma lift-syntomic), use openness of h to place X in the image, then chase Koszul-regular immersions W -> A^{n+m}_Y and X' -> A^{n+m}_Y through Divisors, lemma permanence-regular-immersion to conclude X' -> W Koszul-regular, and fpqc descent of Koszul-regular immersions down to X -> A^n_Y. Retained author proof at lines 18595-18654.
